questions.question: Is the patient being discharged directly from the ED, with no inpatient admission? If she is admitted, please send a negative MRSA swab and a COVID swab taken within 24 hours of arrival.
questions.why: Face sheet and referral form say ED only, but the CalAIM form says 'Currently in Hospital? Yes' (p4). Unclear-rules note: a swab negative at referral can be more than 24 h old by arrival.

questions.question: What are the results of the blood cultures (x2) and the urine culture?
questions.why: All three are 'Order Status: Sent' with no results (p11, p19).

questions.question: Please confirm the extent and onset of the right leg cellulitis.
questions.why: Triage says diagnosed 'about a month ago', HPI says '8 days ago' (p14); HPI describes swelling shin to toes, exam says 'No edema' (p16).

questions.question: Is the patient on any isolation precautions?
questions.why: Isolation is not stated; the CalAIM isolation field is blank (p7).

questions.question: Which oral antibiotic (name, dose, duration) is she being discharged on, and does she have the prescription?
questions.why: She was on doxycycline, got IV cefepime/vancomycin in the ED, and 'ED Prescriptions: None' (p21).

questions.question: Will IV antibiotics or IV access continue after the ED? If yes, has home health been ordered and scheduled to maintain the IV and give the medication?
questions.why: IV antibiotics were given in the ED (p12) but the CalAIM form says 'IV Antibiotics: NO' (p7). Unclear-rules note: the home-health threshold varies ('established' / 'ordered' / 'coordinated').

questions.question: Is she currently taking apixaban (Eliquis)? If yes, can she manage it on her own, and what follow-up is planned?
questions.why: Med list says apixaban 5 mg twice daily (p12, p16); HPI says she was taken off it recently (p14); both forms say no anticoagulants (p3, p7). She has an AF history.

questions.question: Can you send more blood pressure readings showing BP stable on oral losartan over 24 hours?
questions.why: Only one reading, 178/79 (p16); hypertension is not in the PMH.

questions.question: Can you send the confirmed (final) EKG interpretation?
questions.why: ECG is 'Preliminary ... Not Confirmed' (p12) and the provider EKG template is blank (p20).

questions.question: Is a recent ejection fraction available (e.g. from her prior TEE or an echo), and is it her baseline?
questions.why: TEE/cardioversion is in the surgical history without results (p15).

questions.question: Besides the PRN levalbuterol inhaler, is she on any breathing treatments, and does she have her CPAP machine with her?
questions.why: Asthma and OSA 'USES CPAP MACHINE' in PMH (p15); she is recently homeless.

questions.question: Is she under current psychiatric treatment or on any psychiatric medication? Please send the psych notes marked as attached.
questions.why: Bipolar 1 and schizophrenia documented; no psychiatric meds on the home list (p16); 'Current treatment' blank (p7); psych notes absent.

questions.question: Has she been screened for suicidal ideation and for command hallucinations? What were the results?
questions.why: No SI screen anywhere; hallucinations addressed only by an unchecked form box (p3).

questions.question: Is she under, or has she ever been under or considered for, a conservatorship or a Full Service Partnership (FSP)?
questions.why: Packet is silent; she has bipolar 1 and schizophrenia. Unclear-rules note: 'FSP' is not spelled out in the criteria.

questions.question: Please send the PT/OT evaluation marked as attached. Can she walk 100 ft with her walker on her own (modified independence)?
questions.why: RN note: 100 ft with walker (p9); triage 'able to bear some weight' and HPI 'difficulty walking due to back pain' (p14). No PT/OT note in the packet.

questions.question: What did the right foot X-ray and the bilateral leg venous duplex show?
questions.why: Both pending at referral (p12, p21); the foot X-ray bears on osteomyelitis. Unclear-rules note ('Not yet'): workup was incomplete when the referral was sent.

questions.question: Can you send the finished ED provider note with the impression, medical decision-making and disposition filled in?
questions.why: These sections are unfilled templates ('No diagnosis found', 'ED Disposition: None', p21); ED diagnosis 'None' (p10).

questions.question: Can you complete the current IHH referral form (RC0725) with its front-page screening checklist?
questions.why: The packet uses the older LA/OC form (p3), which lacks several screening items.

request_to_referrer: Send the blood culture (x2) and urine culture results.
Send the PT/OT evaluation (marked as attached on the referral form but not included), showing how far she walks with her walker and how much help she needs.
Send the last 5 sets of vital signs with times (temperature, heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2), including readings that show her blood pressure is stable on oral losartan over 24 hours.
Send the finished ED provider note with the diagnosis, decision-making and discharge plan filled in.
Send the discharge medication list and the oral antibiotic she will go home on (name, dose, how long), and confirm she has a 30-day supply of all medications.
Tell us whether she is currently taking Eliquis (apixaban). The medication list, the doctor's note and the referral forms disagree. If she is, confirm she can manage it herself.
Send the psych notes marked as attached, and tell us whether she is on any psychiatric medication or treatment for bipolar disorder and schizophrenia.
Confirm she has been screened for suicidal thoughts and for command hallucinations, with the results.
Tell us whether she is, or has ever been, under a conservatorship or a Full Service Partnership (FSP).
Tell us whether she is on any isolation precautions.
Fill out the current IHH referral form (RC0725), including the front-page screening checklist.
Tell us whether IV antibiotics or an IV line will continue after the ED. If so, send the home health order to maintain the IV and give the medication.
Confirm she is going straight from the ED (not being admitted). If she is admitted, send a negative MRSA swab and a negative COVID swab taken within 24 hours of arrival.
Send the right foot X-ray and leg venous duplex results when they are final.

If available: her ejection fraction (from the prior TEE or an echo) and whether it is her baseline; any respiratory therapy notes; whether she has her CPAP machine and uses any breathing treatments beyond the PRN inhaler.
